milestone: SeLinOS Linux syscall ABI M13 root-tracked ARCH_GET_FS

contract.accepted_request: Only arch_prctl(code=ARCH_GET_FS 0x1003, user word in the mapped test page) after the exact M12 ARCH_SET_FS sequence is accepted.
contract.state: The returned value is only root’s per-probe `probe_tls_base`, recorded after successful M12 seL4_TCB_SetTLSBase to the fixed anonymous test-page address.
contract.probe: The isolated probe verifies zero return and compares the returned word against its retained mapped-page address before its fs:0 test.
contract.negative_scope: This does not read arbitrary remote TCB state and does not support general ARCH_GET_FS, GS, clone inheritance, ELF TLS or dynamic linker semantics.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M13: root-tracked ARCH_GET_FS mapped TLS base returned.
SeLinOS ABI M12: ARCH_SET_FS mapped-page TLS base and fs:0 load/store mediated.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: restricted ARCH_GET_FS rejected.

not_claimed: general ARCH_GET_FS or remote TCB FS-base read capability
arbitrary TLS base state, GS base, clone/fork inheritance or cross-thread TLS
ELF TLS relocations, dynamic linker, glibc or general Linux runtime compatibility
dpkg, apt, package installation or repository access
